name: hvac-dashboard
description: Dev-only manifest. Two independent purposes: (1) the jsdom-based test suites (tests-js/kiosk.test.js, tests-js/dashboard-maintenance.test.js) need jsdom — tests-js/dashboard-functions.test.js stays dependency-free, extracting pure functions straight out of hvac-dashboard.html via sentinel comments rather than needing a DOM at all; (2) eslint/prettier lint and format the standalone tests-js/*.js files. Both are deliberately scoped to tests-js/ only, not frontend/*.html — those ship embedded JS with no build step by design, and running either tool's formatter across ~4,000 lines of already-shipped production markup would produce one enormous, hard-to-review diff (see eslint.config.js and .prettierignore for the full reasoning). The app itself still ships zero client-side dependencies at runtime; everything here is dev-only tooling.
